title: Equal Confusion Fairness: Measuring Group-Based Disparities in Automated Decision Systems
reasoning: The paper's core focus is on developing a methodology to assess 'fairness' and 'accountability' in automated decision systems. These concepts directly relate to ethical considerations and moral principles, as they aim to eliminate 'unjust treatment and discrimination' against sensitive groups. The application to a criminal justice system (COMPAS) further underscores its engagement with the ethical implications of AI.
